en: I'd love to trade Pokémon with someone, but nobody has what I want.
text: Mi-ar plăcea să fac schimb de Pokémoni cu cineva, dar nimeni n-are ce vreau eu.

en: The rock around Rustboro is hard as iron. That's why the tunnel east never got finished.
text: Roca din jurul Rustboro e tare ca fierul. De asta n-a mai fost terminat tunelul spre est.
